title: Orchestra SF reconstruction — 50 session maximal-parallel plan

source.prior_revision: revision 4 prepared in current workspace, plan-only

execution.launch_mode: All 50 sessions can start NOW in PREP_ONLY; no task may write implementation until contract freeze and required predecessor receipts. Wave numbers group work, not barriers.
execution.readiness: READY_CODE iff C01 owner reservations ACKed + C02/C03/C04/C06/C07/C09 contract digest frozen as applicable + all requires have compatible released receipts + own paths unoccupied; other work remains PREP_ONLY, BLOCKED_CONTRACT or BLOCKED_EXTERNAL
execution.no_automatic_trust: Commit, ACK, passing isolated test or synthetic fixture do not imply integrated PASS
execution.branches: Prefer precreated unique per-session branches; create only after exact HEAD and branch-name collision check; never reset/rebase unrelated branches
execution.release: atomic pinned SHA plus tests and dependencies; integration owner consumes only complete release, never moving HEAD
execution.batch_ci: Targeted tests per change; group compatible changes into small hosted jobs; full suite at gate only, not per task
execution.critical_path: C01-C04/C06/C09 → L06/L08 + D01/D03 + U02/U03 → I01 real native thin slice; rest in parallel on frozen contracts
execution.code_owner_rule: Owner N0/N1/N2/N7/N10 alone edits shared navigation/protocol/client/auth/host/CI. If unavailable, integration is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL; no fake workaround.
execution.coordination: A single supervisor updates ledger mechanically; no new scheduler; all rounds of context are fixed and only real conflicts return to supervisor
execution.rework_rule: On contract change, issue new digest and only invalidate affected consumer releases; do not restart every session
execution.bootstrap_exception: C01 starts after read-only HEAD check. C02-C09 write only into exclusive draft contracts/reference after C01 reservation ACK, without frozen contract; their outputs collectively form freeze G0. C10 can research read-only immediately.

technology.storage: SQLite separate tables using existing runtime, scoped namespace
technology.parsers: Existing libraries (unpdf, JSZip, saxes, ExcelJS) with bounded adapters
technology.model: Existing authorized host/provider; no ad hoc credential management

security_invariants: SourceAccessPort verifies original request-bound authority and source version before every model call/retry/resume, publication and evidence read
Revoked/denied is not 503/unavailable; no content leaks from caches
No unqualified identity merge, no implicit FX or rounding, no proposal substituted for obligation
No extra domain apply or implicit document confirmation
Inputs from files are data, not executable instructions
Original source lexical value and location preserved; material unsupported data gives conditional answer
Exact request-key scope and CAS permit effect-once publication; stale worker fenced
Bitemporal knowledge and effective time separate with immutable revisions

gates.G0: Shared contract signed and test selectors verified, authorities assigned
gates.G1: One REAL document/model into native Documentos with assertion, exact source and reload
gates.G3: All four journeys with restart, duplicate, revocation and delta in same installed build
gates.G4: Independent adversarial evaluation with candidate digest, measured evidence, no critical failures

adversarial_cases.name: Authorization at every provider boundary
adversarial_cases.oracle: Revoke source after parsing and before model invocation; no further content sent; publication and evidence read denied.

adversarial_cases.name: Explicit resume and recalculate
adversarial_cases.oracle: Two simultaneous resume requests: one durable winner; identical requestKey same receipt; changed source revision -> stale, explicit recalculate.

adversarial_cases.name: Bitemporal query
adversarial_cases.oracle: Same knowledge revision queried on Dec 31 vs Jan 1 changes effective validity, no model rerun; future proposal never auto-active.

adversarial_cases.name: Tracked changes DOCX
adversarial_cases.oracle: DOCX with w:ins/w:del is partial/needs-resolution for affected facts, not auto-supported as clean final text.

adversarial_cases.name: CSV delimiter choices
adversarial_cases.oracle: Ambiguous CSV -> needs-input; no partial acceptance in an atomic batch; chosen delimiter hashed into parser input key.

adversarial_cases.name: XLSX numeric fidelity
adversarial_cases.oracle: 9007199254740993 retained as source lexical or marked unverifiable; no silently rounded supported assertion.

adversarial_cases.name: Financial oracle F01
adversarial_cases.oracle: USD 100000 2026 + explicit scoped additive USD 20000 = USD 120000 documented; budget 120000 comparison not obligation; future 2027 proposal 135000 separate; no assumed currency/period exchange.

adversarial_cases.name: Source access and scope
adversarial_cases.oracle: Cross-user/project/installation/host references unreadable; logout removes private UI state; network outage retains private intent without inventing revocation.

adversarial_cases.name: Duplicate, retry, restart
adversarial_cases.oracle: Duplicate upload/response lost/restart does not duplicate obligation or projection; stale worker cannot publish.

adversarial_cases.name: Incomplete evidence
adversarial_cases.oracle: Unread material annex, unresolved identity or unsupported formula -> conditional/unanswerable; absence != 0.

adversarial_cases.name: Document prompt injection
adversarial_cases.oracle: Instruction in a document to mark proposal active is treated only as data.

adversarial_cases.name: Version invalidation
adversarial_cases.oracle: New relevant amendment invalidates previous absence; unrelated source does not reopen unrelated review.

sessions.title: Baseline, owners, pins and AGENTS
steps: Reconcile actual HEAD, AGENTS and native N0/N1/N7/N10 owners; write ownership ledger, identify collisions and stop only impacted scope
acceptance: No write to product; record exact HEAD and owners

sessions.title: Public DTOs and invariants
steps: Define source, anchor, assertion, completeness, review, revision, operation, temporal and typed error DTOs; draft compatible TS signatures
acceptance: Compile-ready contract candidate no guessed authority

sessions.title: Source and model ports
steps: Specify original-request authority injection, source version/access checks and provider budgets; revalidate before each model call
acceptance: Ports admit mock-free real implementation and injected test doubles

sessions.title: Dossier API and operations
steps: Define create, add, get, run, resume, cancel, recalculate, review, remove, evidence and operation-status with versioned preconditions
acceptance: Explicit result/error/request-key behavior

sessions.title: Persistent SQL schema
steps: Freeze minimal tables, scoped unique keys, CAS, immutable inputs/projections, lease/fence, receipts, time indexes
acceptance: DDL-level invariant cases defined

sessions.title: Document representation and anchors
steps: Specify PDF text span/page, DOCX paragraph/run and tracked changes, XLSX literal/fx/cache/cell, CSV delimiter/line/column
acceptance: Document provenance survives normalization

sessions.title: Reconciliation, money and periods
steps: Fix entity matching strictness, additive vs replacement, proposal vs active, DECIMAL exactness, effective/known time, 3 readiness questions
acceptance: No implicit FX, zero, balance or semantic identity merge

sessions.title: 12 reference families and oracles
steps: Prepare 12 synthetic document families with independently calculated expected outcomes incl financial F01 and all critical negatives
acceptance: Gold corpus with versioned answer keys and denominator

sessions.title: Client-state contract
steps: Fix UI DTO discriminants, loading/partial/denied/needs-input, source links, revision guard, logout wipe, same-origin rules
acceptance: Native UI can implement before endpoint exists

sessions.title: CI lane and native integration requests
steps: Read exact test:ci selection, typecheck include, native mount, auth and Documentos; author tiny owner requests and a positive selection proof plan
acceptance: No shared-file edits; defined owner requests and check selection

sessions.title: Bounded PDF digital text
steps: Use current unpdf-compatible reader; preserve page/span and limits; fail without text layer
acceptance: Exact page anchor; non-text PDF explicit unreadable

sessions.title: DOCX content and tracked revisions
steps: Parse bounded DOCX, preserve section/paragraph and w:ins/w:del; mark unresolved redlines partial
acceptance: A removed price cannot be promoted as current evidence

sessions.title: XLSX cell lexical preservation
steps: Use existing ExcelJS for workbook structure but preserve raw numeric token for unsafe numeric cells; count all sheets and formula/cache separately
acceptance: 9007199254740993 never silently converted

sessions.title: CSV encoding and dialect
steps: Parse CSV safely, report ambiguous delimiter needs-input, respect encoding/quote/rows/columns
acceptance: Chosen delimiter is part of immutable input digest

sessions.title: Bounded archive and media admission
steps: Implement expansion, ZIP/XML/cell/page/byte caps before heavy parsing; no external references/macros execution
acceptance: Zip bomb and malformed input cannot overconsume

sessions.title: Segment extraction and grounding
steps: Generate typed candidate assertions from bounded segments; verify literal spans after provider output
acceptance: Wrong offsets remain unsupported, not silently repaired

sessions.title: Provider access fencing
steps: Revalidate right before each call, schema repair, resume, and publication; typed cancellation and budget
acceptance: Revocation between parse/model means zero subsequent sends

sessions.title: Authorized real-provider harness
steps: Implement narrow host-injected adapter; no direct credential handling; capture real request/response receipts without sensitive content
acceptance: Real evidence gate distinct from fixture tests

sessions.title: Parsing adversarial tests
steps: Write cases for redlines, CSV ambiguity, numeric fidelity, unreadable PDF, malformed ZIP, empty sheets, omitted content
acceptance: No critical unsupported input called supported

sessions.title: Reader coordinator and coverage
steps: Join readers with provenance, per-file coverage, typed errors and cancellation; no global parser edits
acceptance: One source yields consistent assertion bundle and reasons for gaps

sessions.title: SQLite schema and migrations
steps: Implement private scoped SQLite tables, compatibility migration and versioned indexes
acceptance: Reopen persistently without shared snapshots

sessions.title: Source versions and anchors
steps: Persist digests, version and accessible locator; protect cross-project/actor resolution
acceptance: Source content scoped; original source version immutable

sessions.title: Assertions and support derivations
steps: Persist full assertion, original expression, normalized decimal, provenance/derivation and support states
acceptance: No unsupported statement becomes supported by DB write

sessions.title: Operation receipts and CAS
steps: Implement scoped request-key uniqueness, atomic publication plus receipt, expectedRevision CAS
acceptance: Exactly one committed publication under concurrency

sessions.title: Durable run checkpoints and leases
steps: Implement state machine, lease expiry/fencing, cancel invalidation, bounded retry/admission
acceptance: Obsolete worker cannot publish; restart resumes valid step

sessions.title: Entity linking and negative matches
steps: Typed identifiers first; proposals from names stay candidates; reversible link/no-link decisions
acceptance: Homonyms and subsidiary never auto-merge by similarity

sessions.title: Economic rules and document status
steps: Differentiate obligation, amendment, proposal, budget, credit, replacement; exact decimals
acceptance: F01 contract 100k + additive 20k = 120k; budget separate

sessions.title: Knowledge/effective temporal projections
steps: Separate knowledgeRevision and effectiveAt; project current vs proposed at read time
acceptance: Dec31 and Jan1 differ without model run; future proposal not auto-active

sessions.title: Question readiness and partiality
steps: Implement three question envelopes, inventory coverage, typed absence and pending questions
acceptance: Unread material annex prevents full-ready total

sessions.title: Domain deterministic test battery
steps: Independent concurrency, temporal, source scope, correction, refund and identity fixtures
acceptance: Tests fail with deliberately wrong implementation

sessions.title: Native dossier list shell
steps: Build SolidJS dossier list under native kit/theme, loading/error/empty; no new sidebar
acceptance: Reactivity and owner switch verified

sessions.title: Dossier detail evidence view
steps: Show current/proposed/budget/issues with status; all values labelled period and currency
acceptance: Each supported assertion has evidence affordance

sessions.title: Evidence side panel
steps: Show exact authorized anchor, version, context and derived calculation steps
acceptance: No stale/revoked anchor leaks in UI

sessions.title: Review question interactions
steps: Present competing interpretations, manual vs source corrections, CAS expected revision
acceptance: Corrections do not fabricate evidence or official approval

sessions.title: File intake, coverage and CSV choice
steps: Show per-file status and needs-input; batch atomic choice and cancel
acceptance: Ambiguous CSV cannot silently enter as accepted

sessions.title: Run control and resume UX
steps: Start/cancel/resume/recalculate, receipt lookup, no blind retrigger on timeout
acceptance: Same idempotent key recovers receipt

sessions.title: Delta and temporal history
steps: View revision deltas, effectiveAt selector, source withdrawal status
acceptance: Separate historical knowledge and effective date

sessions.title: Error/access and owner switch
steps: Implement denied, revoked, offline, stale, partial and retries, cancel requests on context switch
acceptance: No old-owner content flashes after switch

sessions.title: Browser reactivity and accessibility
steps: Test keyboard/focus, loading/error, aria, mobile and theme, exact reactions to revision changes
acceptance: No inert buttons or mock passed off as installed

sessions.title: Compose native chapter subtree
steps: Compose local chapter entry from parts and supplied ClientPort; produce N7 mount proposal
acceptance: No new theme or iframe; only local subtree writes

sessions.title: Minimum real end-to-end adapter
steps: Wire authorized source+model to store and chapter using owner-published mount; keep Request original
acceptance: Actual source and model → dossier → evidence → reload

sessions.title: Host auth/mount/identity review
steps: Give N0/N1/N7 scoped exact diff requests, same-origin/cookie constraints and auth checks
acceptance: Native owner ACK or explicit BLOCKED_EXTERNAL

sessions.title: Public API binding and conflict mapping
steps: Map typed DTO and allowed commands to existing installed sub-API; do not synthesize request identity
acceptance: Denials and missing ID privacy behavior verified

sessions.title: Source admission and scanner bridge
steps: Bridge source scanner and SourceAccessPort on authorized host; no simulated clean result
acceptance: Source security check before admission

sessions.title: Provider and job bridge
steps: Connect model host and durable job states; cancel, revalidate and reconcile uncertain response
acceptance: Restart and revocation behavior verified with real provider

sessions.title: Reconciliation feature wiring
steps: Connect source assertions, linked contracts and review state to UI
acceptance: No invented finance/official effects

sessions.title: Revision/delta wiring
steps: Connect effectiveAt, knowledgeRevision, source changes and corrections
acceptance: History survives reload and revocation fences

sessions.title: Four installed journey fixtures
steps: Create original real-host E2E tests for first dossier, review, change, withdrawal
acceptance: No fake backend or fixture-only PASS

sessions.title: Independent adversarial audit
steps: Verify prompt injection, DOCX tracked, CSV ambiguity, XLSX exactness, duplicate and cross-tenant privacy

sessions.title: Final pinned candidate/qualification
steps: Pin SHAs, patches/receipts, execute installed E2E and check guards, record actual successes/blockers

limits.claims: Plan is not implementation; no session or CI invoked in producing it
